Inglewood, California
  October 15, 2019

The Housing Authority of the City of Inglewood, California held a regular meeting on
Tuesday, October 15, 2019, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.

APPOINTMENT OF MAYOR PRO TEM. It was moved by Council Member Padilla,
and seconded by Council Member Dotson that the City Council does hereby appoint
Council Member Franklin as Mayor Pro Tem for closed session. The motion was carried
by the following roll call vote:
Ayes: Council Members Dotson and Padilla, Mayor Pro Tem Franklin;
Noes: None; and
Absent: Mayor Butts and Council Member Morales.
Mayor Pro Tem Franklin called the City Council/Housing Authority into joint session for
Closed Session at the hour of 1:05 p.m.
The City Clerk/Housing Secretary announced the presence of a quorum as follows:
  Present:  Mayor Pro Tem/Housing Authority Chairman Pro Tem
  Franklin, Council Members/Housing Authority Members
  Dotson, and Padilla; and
  Absent:  Mayor/Housing Authority Chairman Butts and
  Council Member/Housing Authority Member Morales.
City/Housing Authority officials and personnel present for closed session were as
follows:

  Yvonne Horton  City Clerk/Secretary*
  Artie Fields  City Manager/Executive Director*
  Ken Campos  City Attorney/General Counsel*
  Aisha Thompson  Deputy City Clerk

* Serves as indicated for the Housing Authority.

PUBLIC COMMENTS REGARDING CLOSED SESSION ITEMS. Mayor Pro
Tem/Housing Authority Chairman Pro Tem Franklin inquired if there were any persons
present who wished to address the City Council/Housing Authority on the Closed Session
Items.

There was no response.

Mayor Pro Tem/Housing Authority Chairman Pro Tem Franklin recessed the City
Council/Housing Authority at the hour of 1:07 p.m. for Closed Session Item Nos. CS-1 &
CHS-1 and CS-2 & CHS-2.

  *****************

Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called the
City Council into joint session with the Successor Agency and Housing Authority, at the
hour of 2:04 p.m.
The City Clerk/ Successor Agency Secretary/ Housing Authority Secretary announced
the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Mayor/Successor  Agency  Chairman/Housing
  Authority Chairman Butts, Council Members/Successor
  Agency Members/Housing Authority Members Dotson,
  Padilla and Franklin; and

  Absent:  Council Member/Successor Agency Member/ Housing
  Authority Member Morales.

  David Esparza  Asst. City Manager/CFO

  PUBLIC COMMENTS – AGENDA ITEMS.  Mayor/Successor Agency
  Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman Butts inquired if there were any persons present
  who wished to address the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority on any
  item on the Agenda.

  There was no response.

 142.9  PAYMENT OF WARRANTS AND BILLS. It was moved by Council Member
  /Successor Agency Member / Housing Authority Member Franklin, and seconded by
  Council Member /Successor Agency Member / Housing Authority Member Dotson that
  the demands presented to the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority dated,
  October 11, 2019, in the amount of $3,304,060.48, are hereby allowed, and the City
  Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary is hereby authorized to
  certify upon said registers that said demands are so approved. The motion was carried by
  the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members/Successor Agency Members/Housing Authority Members
  Dotson, Padilla, Franklin and Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Housing
  Authority Chairman Butts;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Council Member/Successor Agency Member/Housing Authority Member
  Morales.

 142  FISCAL YEAR 2017-2018 FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AND SINGLE AUDIT
  FOR THE CITY OF INGLEWOOD AND INGLWEOOD HOUSING
  AUTHORITY RECEIVED AND FILED. Staff report dated October 15, 2019,
  presented the Fiscal Year 2017-2018 Financial Statements and Single Audit for the City
  of Inglewood and the Inglewood Housing Authority.

  After receiving an oral presentation by the City’s audit Firm, Lance, Soll & Lunghard,
  LLP, on the City’s Fiscal Year 2017-2018 Basic Financial Statements and Single Audit
  Report on Federal Award, it was moved by Council Member Franklin, and seconded by
  Council Member Padilla that the City Council does hereby receive and file the City’s
  Basic Financial Statements and Single Audit Report on Federal Awards for Fiscal Year
  2017-2018. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Franklin and Mayor Butts;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Council Member Morales.

  It was moved by Housing Authority Member Franklin, and seconded by Housing
  Authority Member Padilla that the Housing Authority does hereby receive and file the
  City of Inglewood Basic Financial Statements which includes the Housing Authority
  financial accounts for Fiscal year 2017-2018. The motion was carried by the following
  roll call vote:
  Ayes: Housing Authority Members Dotson, Padilla, Franklin, and Housing Authority
  Chairman Butts;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Housing Authority Member Morales.
